content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the renaming of the `printk_sched` function to `printk_deferred` in a previous commit. This change led to compilation or runtime errors in the `wd_kicker.c` file, as the code was still using the old function name `printk_sched`. The patch corrects these errors by replacing all instances of `printk_sched` with the new function name `printk_deferred`, ensuring that the logging functionality works as intended.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: printk_sched("[WDK], local_bit:0x%x, cpu:%d, check bit0x:%x,RT[%lld]\n", local_bit, cpu, wk_check_kick_bit(),sched_clock());
printk_sched("[WDK]: cpu:%d, kick local wdt,RT[%lld]\n", cpu,sched_clock());
